messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

team.description: Optionally the specific team to consider. Eg. Liverpool

message.content:
**All‑time Premier League assist record**

| Player | Club(s) | Total Premier League assists |
|--------|---------|------------------------------|
| **Ryan Giggs** | Manchester United | **162** |

Ryan Giggs holds the record for the most assists ever recorded in the Premier League, with 162 assists over his 18‑year career from 1990 to 2009.

---

### If you’re looking for the *current season* (2025/26)

The Premier League’s official statistics site (or the club’s own data feeds) will list the top assist provider for the ongoing season. As of the last update I have (end of 2023/24), the season‑to‑date leader was **Kevin De Bruyne** (Manchester City) with 12 assists. For the most up‑to‑date figure, check the Premier League’s live stats or the club’s official website.
